newsitem.title: FRANCE: Knowledge TV to be carried by France's TPS.
newsitem.headline: Knowledge TV to be carried by France's TPS.

text.p: Knowledge TV, a U.S. channel dedicated to education, announced on Thursday that it would be carried by the French digital satellite television service TPS beginning next month.
In a statement released in the French capital, Knowledge TV added that it was also in "advanced talks" with several French cable operators.
Knowledge TV is owned by Jones Education Networks Inc, which announced plans last October for an initial public offering of shares.
TPS is owned by TF1, France Television, France Telecom, Lyonnaise des Eaux and CLT-UFA.
